title: Cyte-09
extract:
Release Date: December 13, 2024
Locked and loaded with his bullseye on the prize, nothing evades his crosshairs. A flash of gunfire before quickly repositioning, empowering his weapons to quickly eliminate his next targets. Whatever his original name was is lost to history, but he goes by a new designation: Cyte-09. Proximity alert at the rendezvous... impromptu target practice, right on cue. Cyte-09 set his sights on Update 38.0 (2024-12-13): 1999.
 Cyte-09 is a marksman Warframe that carries long-ranged attacks and stealth. His Passive grants increased Critical Chance on Weak Point kills.  Seek plants an antennae that highlight enemies through walls while increasing their vulnerability to weak point damage and increases Cyte-09's weapon Punch Through,  Resupply deploys ammo packs that increases elemental damage of a selected type, and  Evade renders Cyte-09 Invisible which can be extended with weak point kills.  Neutralize summons the exalted sniper rifle  Neutralizer, whose weak point hits ricochet to adjacent enemies and has an Alternate Fire that launches a  Cold grenade.

Acquisition
Cyte-09's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of The Hex quest. His component blueprints are acquired from Höllvania Central Mall Bounties as an uncommon drop.
Alternatively Cyte-09's blueprints can be purchased from Amir of  The Hex; component blueprints for  20,000 and requires Rank 2 - Fresh Slice, and the main blueprint for  50,000 and requires Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

Crafting

Lore & History

Crafted by the  Orokin to carry out highly sensitive missions, this Warframe was never given an actual name, only addressed by its batch name: Cyte-09.
After the fall of the Orokin, Cyte-09 would disappear during the ensuing chaos.

Notes
Currently,  Reconifex lacks a Signature Weapon bonus with Cyte-09.

Trivia
Cyte-09 is the 59th unique Warframe to be released.
Despite being revealed first at TennoCon 2024, Cyte-09 releases after  Koumei, the 58th unique Warframe.
His full ability showcase was demonstrated in Devstream 183, after the dedicated Warframe: 1999 update page unveiled the ability descriptions.
Sketches for Cyte-09 were conceptualized by artist Keith Thompson many years before his formal reveal in TennoCon 2024, under the codename "Frumentarius". He would have had chemical themes, implying that Cyte-09's original concept art might have been intended for  Lavos at first.
The frumentarii were a Roman intelligence service active between the second and fourth centuries CE, acting primarily as secret police and carrying out assassinations on the emperor's behalf, similarly to how Cyte-09 was meant to "eliminate sensitive problems" for the Orokin.
The devs revealed that they had initially designed Cyte-09 to be a first-person Warframe, but early development efforts revealed that there were too many existing aspects of the game that would need to be adjusted for this perspective to work properly, and the feature was cut.
Cyte-09 is the first Warframe to include a hyphen and numbers in their name.
The name Cyte may refer to the Technocyte Virus, which itself is named after the mutagenic virus of Dark Sector.
The full name, Cyte-09, may also be a play on the term 'Cytokine', the proteins that activate and supress various parts of a body's cell responses, particularly the immune system.
Cyte-09 is the first Warframe to have an Exalted Sniper Rifle.
Cyte-09 is the first Warframe to have its Protoframe variant revealed before the Warframe itself.
His second ability,  Resupply, is the first ability to utilize the Gear wheel user interface for multiple features selection.
It is the second Warframe ability after  Protea's  Dispensary to produce Ammo pickups.
Cyte-09 produces radio chatter noise when casting his abilities.
When moving, Cyte-09 produces army uniform shuffling sounds as his footstep audio.
Whether intentionally or coincidentally, Cyte-09's base health, shields and energy, together with the maximum Overshield cap for Warframes and his '09' batch number, sum up to 325  +  235  +  230  +  1200  +  9  =  1999.
